messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
privacy is probably going to be weakened by surveillance and data sharing, yet total loss is not inevitable if regulations and encryption remain strong privacy
consciousness copying by the early 2030s is extremely unlikely because full brain mapping and subjective experience are still far beyond current science consciousness
wireless internet anywhere on Earth is quite plausible in near future thanks to satellites and small cells, though true seamless coverage everywhere remains difficult wireless
transport becoming fully electric is likely over long term for road vehicles, less certain for aviation and shipping due to energy density and infrastructure limits transport
climate effects becoming irreversible is possible for some changes and already partly happening for others, so the prediction is mixed and depends on timescales climate
money disappearing completely is unlikely in the short term because cash serves privacy, resilience, and trust, although it will probably become much less common money
genetic secrets enabling centuries or forever life are highly uncertain, maybe possible as radical life extension but not within foreseeable decades genetics
